visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with dark, messy hair and a cream-colored patterned sweater stares intensely at his smartphone with a worried facial expression. Dramatic black-and-white graphic lines emanate from his head to emphasize shock. In the lower-left corner, a young woman with long wavy hair and bangs appears in a circular video inset, speaking rapidly with animated facial movements. (2) The scene transitions to a full-screen view of the woman in a brightly lit indoor space with white walls. She wears a high-necked white sweater and expressive makeup. She holds a white ceramic mug in one hand and presents a dark red capsule between her fingers to the camera. The background is slightly out of focus, showing a domestic or studio setting. (3) A product display shot features a white cardboard box and a clear glass bottle with a silver lid, both labeled "DAYWEL OptiLut." The bottle is filled with numerous red capsules. The items are placed on a light-colored surface under even, bright studio lighting. No people are visible in this specific product close-up shot. (4) The woman returns to the frame, holding the supplement box and pointing at the printed text on the back. Large, colorful text overlays and a circular graphic with a scientific diagram appear on the screen to highlight product features. The woman continues to speak directly to the viewer with frequent hand gestures and eye contact. (5) An extreme close-up focuses on the woman's right eye, showing clear skin and well-applied eyeliner. She then uses her hands to pull apart a red capsule, spilling its fine brownish powder into the white cap of the bottle. Her fingers are well-manicured, and the lighting is sharp, emphasizing the texture of the powder. (6) The woman appears in a series of shots, first outdoors in a tan beret and a beige cardigan, holding a glass of bright yellow liquid in a sunny park-like setting. The camera then cuts back to the indoor studio where she holds the supplement bottle near her face, smiling broadly while pointing at her cheek. (7) In the final sequence, the woman is seen smiling outdoors in the sun, followed by another close-up of her bright eyes. She then stands indoors, holding both the bottle and the box, gesturing toward them and smiling warmly. The video concludes with her looking directly at the camera, conveying a sense of satisfaction and friendliness.

The background music maintains its upbeat energy, and a subtle "pop" sound effect is heard as visual elements change. There is a high speech density with very few pauses, indicating a well-rehearsed or scripted delivery. (3) The vocal quality is clear and resonant, with a professional broadcasting-like clarity. The speaker details technical product information, using a slightly higher pitch to emphasize specific percentages. The BGM remains at a consistent volume level, providing a cheerful acoustic environment under the narration without masking the speech. (4) A distinct "ding" sound effect marks a transition to discussing certifications and scientific data. The speaker's voice shows high dominance and confidence. The ambient noise floor is extremely low, suggesting a controlled studio recording. The music's rhythm remains synchronized with the pace of her delivery, which is fast but intelligible. (5) The speaker's tone shifts to a more casual and friendly style as she shares her personal daily routine. She speaks with a smiling vocal posture, which is perceived as a brighter spectral quality. The background music continues seamlessly, featuring a simple major-mode harmonic structure that enhances the positive valence of the message. (6) In the concluding phase, the speaker's vocal intensity increases slightly to deliver a final recommendation and call to action. A soft riser sound effect builds tension slightly before a final percussive hit. The overall signal-to-noise ratio is excellent, with the voice clearly separated from the background music and effects.

It establishes credibility through technical certifications and a physical demonstration of the product's capsule contents, ultimately encouraging the audience to invest in eye health through this specific product.
